summary: Community Organizations and Clean Energy Advocates, represented by Earthjustice, move in a motion dated November 17, 2026, in ER27-526-000, for a 30-day extension to comment on MISO's large load filing. They cite pending federal legislation and the number of related MISO filings. They ask for a ruling by November 23, 2026.
ask: Extend the time to comment on MISO's filing to January 15, 2027, and rule by November 23, 2026.

points.point: The movants ask for a 30-day extension of the comment period on MISO's November 16 filing.
points.quote: move for a 30-day extension of time to submit comments on Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc.’s (“MISO”) November 16, 2026 filing

points.point: First reason: Congress is debating a bill that could bear on MISO's filing.
points.quote: Congress is actively debating the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act (“BAAJA”)

points.point: They say a section of the bill on transmission cost allocation may conflict with MISO's filing.
points.quote: BAAJA Section 2107 contains directives regarding transmission cost allocation that may be inconsistent with MISO’s filing

points.point: Second reason: the ordinary comment period is too short for this proceeding.
points.quote: the ordinary comment period is insufficient to allow parties to address the many issues raised by this complex and lengthy proceeding

points.point: They say MISO has split its response across at least four other section 205 filings.
points.quote: MISO has filed at least four piecemeal 205 filings prior to, or simultaneous with, the instant matter

points.point: They ask for a comment date on the motion and a ruling within a week.
points.quote: request the Commission set a comment date of November 19, 2026, on this motion, and render a decision by November 23, 2026

points.point: The requested new deadline is January 15, 2027.
points.quote: GRANTING the requested extension of time, until January 15, 2027, to comment on MISO’s filing

throughLine.text: Asks for more time to comment on MISO's section 205 filing, the filing MISO made to answer the E-8 show cause order. The change would align MISO's comment date with the 60 days PJM requested.
